name: I Got Transported Into A Different World And Turned Into An Infamous Holy Crimson Dragon-Warriror LVL 99999
source:
Felix is a sad, lonely weeb stuck in his room, watching anime and playing video games. Until one day, his toilet transports him into a new world. An Isekai World. 

There he gets saved by brother and sister, kinda like the Avatar, but a bit worse, cheaper version, with more profanity, less likable characters, and no cute animals.

So Felix and his new friends embark on the adventure to try and save the Ende kingdom from the encroaching mysterious fog that surrounds it. They will fight monsters, meet even more companions, fight bandits, visit new places, fight river bandits, learn valuable lessons, and fight evil fog cultists.

Will Felix be able to save everyone by using all the knowledge gained from watching isekai anime, or will he doom this world and lead to its demise and endless darkness?

[From [url=https://sablefish.itch.io/infamous-holy-crimson-dragon-warriror-lvl99999]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
菲利克斯是一个悲伤、孤独的孩子，他被困在自己的房间里，看动漫、玩电子游戏。直到有一天，厕所把他带进了一个新世界。异世界。

在那里，他被兄弟姐妹救了，有点像阿凡达，但更糟糕，更便宜的版本，有更多的脏话，不太讨人喜欢的角色，也没有可爱的动物。

因此，菲利克斯和他的新朋友踏上了冒险之旅，试图将恩德王国从包围它的神秘迷雾中拯救出来。他们将与怪物战斗，结识更多同伴，与强盗战斗，访问新的地方，与河匪战斗，学习宝贵的教训，并与邪雾邪教徒战斗。

菲利克斯能否利用观看异世界动画中获得的所有知识来拯救所有人，还是他会毁灭这个世界并导致它的灭亡和无尽的黑暗？

[来自[url=https://sablefish.itch.io/infamous-holy-crimson-dragon-warriror-lvl99999]itch.io[/url]]
